sql.if: WITH RECURSIVE medata_set_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dt1.medata_set_id, dt1.medata_set_id AS root_id, 1 AS depth FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data dt1 WHERE dt1.geodata_val IS NOT NULL AND dtmeta.ST_Contains( dtmeta.ST_SetSRID( dtmeta.ST_GeomFromText(#{polygon}), 4326 ), dtmeta.ST_SetSRID(dt1.geodata_val, 4326) ) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT dt1.medata_set_id, ids.root_id, ids.depth + 1 FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data dt1 JOIN medata_set_ids ids ON dt1.medata_val = ids.medata_set_id WHERE ids.depth < 10 )
AND ( t1.medata_set_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchText}, '%') OR t1.medata_set_logic_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{srchText}, '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM medata_set_ids ids WHERE ids.medata_set_id = t1.medata_set_id )

/* SQL_ID: MetadataSearchMapper.selectMetadataCount */
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t3.medata_set_id) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t1.model_id = t2.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t4 ON t2.type_model_id = t4.model_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t3 ON t1.medata_set_id = t3.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' WHERE 1=1

/* SQL_ID: MetadataSearchMapper.selectMetadataList */
SELECT DISTINCT t3.medata_set_id , t1.medata_set_nm COLLATE "ko-KR-x-icu" , t1.medata_set_logic_nm , t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd , c1.mtcd_nm AS medata_set_sttus_mtcd_nm , t4.model_nm AS type_model_nm , t4.model_logic_nm AS type_model_logic_nm , t2.model_nm , t2.model_logic_nm FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t1.model_id = t2.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t4 ON t2.type_model_id = t4.model_id INNER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t3 ON t1.medata_set_id = t3.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_portal_code c1 ON t1.medata_set_sttus_mtcd = c1.mtcd AND c1.mtcd_grp_id = 'MCG00001' WHERE 1=1

WITH RECURSIVE medata_hierarchy AS ( SELECT t1.medata_set_id, t1.model_id, t1.medata_set_nm, t1.medata_set_logic_nm, t1.medata_set_desc, t2.type_model_id, t3.prpty_id, t3.val_model_id, t3.medata_val, 1 AS depth FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t2.model_id = t1.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t3 ON t3.medata_set_id = t1.medata_set_id WHERE t1.medata_set_id = #{digitalTwinId} UNION ALL SELECT t1.medata_set_id, t1.model_id, t1.medata_set_nm, t1.medata_set_logic_nm, t1.medata_set_desc, t2.type_model_id, t3.prpty_id, t3.val_model_id, t3.medata_val, mh.depth + 1 FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model t2 ON t2.model_id = t1.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_data t3 ON t3.medata_set_id = t1.medata_set_id INNER JOIN medata_hierarchy mh ON t1.medata_set_id = mh.medata_val WHERE mh.depth < 10 ) SELECT distinct medata_val FROM medata_hierarchy WHERE val_model_id = 'idString'
